items.prompt: Listen. Lucy says: On Friday we have art and music at school. What lessons does Lucy have on Friday?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the two lessons.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Art and music.

items.prompt: Listen. Jack says: I usually have toast for breakfast, but today I am having cereal. What is Jack having today?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the word "today".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.

items.prompt: Listen. Teacher says: The museum opens at nine thirty and closes at five o'clock. What time does it open?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Opens is the start. Closes is the end.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Nine thirty.

items.prompt: Listen. Maya says: My sister is taller than me, but my brother is the tallest in our family. Who is the tallest?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Taller and tallest are different. Listen for "the tallest".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Her brother.

items.prompt: Listen. Ravi says: I was ill last week, so I did not go to school. This week I feel better. Why did Ravi miss school?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the word after "was".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: He was ill.

items.prompt: Listen. Mum says: First wash the potatoes, then cut them, and last put them in the pan. What do you do after you cut the potatoes?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the order words: first, then, last.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Put them in the pan.

items.prompt: Listen. Nina says: We are going to the beach tomorrow, if it does not rain. What will Nina do if it rains?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "if it does not rain".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: She will not go to the beach.

items.prompt: Listen. Ben says: The zoo is next to the library, and the library is opposite the school. Where is the zoo?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
The zoo is next to which place?
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
